notes.title: Pooling Fixed (Again)
notes.content:
What did I say just a few hours ago? Seems like I never do anything fully right the first time. I removed the life time from enemies so they no longer are destroyed (deleted) after 2 minutes. This was causing an issue where the pool would stop filling if enemies were not killed.

List:
1. Pooling fixed (again) enemies no longer are deleted after 2 minutes which would remove them from the pool permanently (stop spawning them if not killed)

notes.title: Object Pooling Fixed | Enemy Movement No Longer Tied To Frame Rate
notes.content:
"With Great Power Come Great Respoinsibility"
This is definitely true with code, seems like I never do anything fully right the first time anymore. Objects were not returning to pool correctly, which results in no enemies spawning after a while. This has been fixed. Also enemy movement have been moved to a FixedUpdate like player movement was to prevent it being tied to physics or FPS.

Short list:
1. Pooling fixed, enemies now returned to pool (correctly) and are like-wise able to be pooled again. This is a method to re-use objects instead to creating new ones every time an enemy spawns.
2. Enemy movement fixed, no longer tied to game physics or FPS.

notes.title: MAJOR IMPROVEMENTS! Movement Speed Finally Fixed! Object Pooling Added!
notes.content:
So when you start making bigger games you realize all the things you did wrong in your smaller games... I've (successfully this time) added object pooling which will increase performance and reduce crashes. But mileage may vary between PC's.
Movement speed is finally fixed. The problem was not using a FixedUpdate with deltaTime, this was a simple error on my part for not understanding physics yet fully. Also camera flashing has been fixed on game start. And I removed the 300 fps frame rate limit.

Here's a short list:
1. Player movement no longer tied to FPS (higher fps was making the player slower!)
2. Object pooling added for all standard enemies, this should help performance
3. 300 fps limit removed when v-sync is off
4. Red flash is now enabled on game start, use pause menu > camera FX off to disable this setting

notes.title: Spawn Rate Update. Version 1.3 Is Out!
notes.content:
So to keep this short. I increased the spawn rate by double, but I also increased the spawn max on easy, medium, and hard. I excluded very hard as it seems better with double rate. 
This being said, it SHOULD make the game more exciting without having to wait 20-30mins for more furries.
However it may impact achievement progress. Hitting wave 50 should be possible on easy mode. Hitting 1 million will still be a trick. I think I may increase the score amount globally to try to help with that issue next update.

Also Endless Furry Killer 3D launches Monday!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1519470/Endless_Furry_Killer_3D/

notes.title: Performance Improvement Update!
notes.content:
So first off, I reduced the spawn rate per wave by 66.6666 (Repeating of course) percent!
Second off, furries will de-spawn after 50 seconds. This seems shot but its actually not that short, as each wave is 40 seconds. Leaving 10 seconds to kill the remaining furries before you will have to click the "next wave" button.

With that being said there's really not much more to it. You should be able to hit higher waves now. Unfortunately I lost my game tester. I'm hiring a personal friend in 2020 to help with game ideas, testing, and level design. He actually thought of the idea for Endless Furry Killer 2020. We already have our next game planned.
